solution: I went to smoke cigarettes with my friends but we forget to open the windows and turn on the exhaust fan. Due to the poor ventilation, we accidentally triggered the fire alarm. (Disclaimer: this puzzle is NOT based on any real incidents)
canonical_facts: The narrator and friends smoke cigarettes in the pantry
They fail to open windows and turn on the exhaust fan
Poor ventilation allows cigarette smoke to trigger the fire alarm rather than a building fire
An unused exhaust fan and closed windows are omissions/conditions, not an extra affirmative act of operating an appliance.
explicit_negatives: The source was cigarette smoke, not cooking grease fumes.
unknown_details: Exact headcount beyond narrator and friends, precise cigarette lighting time, detector placement and arrival order are unspecified.
irrelevant_details: Appliance brand, exact temperature, clothing and room dimensions are incidental.
Whether the hall is specifically a student residence, watcher/staff biographies, and whether smoking was against a rule are not needed.
